lightmap.options.minimap.show.tooltip: Draws the minimap in the top-left corner. The map is recorded either way.
lightmap.options.minimap.opacity.tooltip: How solid the minimap is. Lower values let the game show through; at 0% it is not drawn.
lightmap.options.minimap.size.tooltip: Side of the minimap in screen pixels. It stays the same size at any GUI scale.
lightmap.options.minimap.rotate.tooltip: Turns the minimap so the direction you look is up. Off keeps north up.
lightmap.marker.name: Name
lightmap.marker.minimap_name: Show its name on the minimap
lightmap.options.minimap.marker_size.too: How markers are drawn on the minimap. Small is a plain square; Medium and Large are bigger and have a dark outline.
lightmap.options.minimap.label_scale.too: Size of marker names and player names on the minimap.
lightmap.options.minimap.players.tooltip: Shows other players on the minimap as their face, their name or both, for every player the server has told your game about, including sneaking and invisible ones. Check a server's rules before using it there.
